moves.name: Fly
notes: Each bullet deals 0.1–0.3%, which its script does not state: it passes 0 and the engine sets the power from its params (param_inkbullet.last_attack, param_inkbullet.default_attack). It leaves the muzzle at default_attack and falls to last_attack as it slows over its life.

moves.name: Explode
notes: The explosion deals 10–16%, which its script does not state: it passes 0 and the engine sets the power from its params (param_splashbomb.min_attack, param_splashbomb.max_attack). Charging the throw is what raises it.
